about_short_description.short_description: Inversion builds space capsules to return cargo back to Earth for the commercial, civil, and defense industries.

product.name: Arc
product.description: An autonomous, reusable spacecraft designed to deliver cargo from low Earth orbit to precise locations on Earth and support hypersonic testing and orbital logistics missions.

product.name: Space-Based Cargo Delivery
product.description: An orbital logistics service using autonomous reentry vehicles to return mission-critical cargo from low Earth orbit to precise locations on Earth, with a stated delivery goal of under one hour.

product.name: Hypersonic Testing with Arc
product.description: A hypersonic testbed service using Arc’s maneuverable, autonomous reentry vehicle to provide extended hypersonic flight and customer-configured test conditions for payloads and systems.

product.name: Orbital Logistics with Arc
product.description: An in-space logistics capability in which Arc operates as a reusable satellite to capture or deploy assets, rendezvous with spacecraft, and remain on orbit for extended missions.

product.name: Ray
product.description: A small spacecraft and reentry capsule used to validate technologies, processes, and operational capabilities for Inversion’s future vehicles, including Arc.
